spec.name: Trend v25
spec.notes: Classic trend signal on trailing returns. Weekly rebalance.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.0, annual return 10%, maximum drawdown 6%.

charges.argument: The strategy's claimed performance is based on a single research-period backtest without any validation on out-of-sample data, which is a classic knife-edge problem.
